summary: Frontend testing of new 'Monitor del servidor' (super admin only). All required flows work: super admin login shows nav-monitor + nav-pagos; monitor page renders with tabs Sistema (gauges CPU=38%, RAM=53%, Swap=0%, Uptime card, disks, servicios, integraciones MongoDB/Likes/Stripe/Email, top procesos, Auto 5s checkbox, Actualizar btn); Dominios & Ataques tab shows amber warning about /var/www/vhosts (expected in preview); Cambios de archivos tab has changes-hours selector and amber note (expected); Plesk tab shows host + apikey inputs (writable), Guardar y probar btn, and 'Abrir panel de Plesk' correctly disabled (no key configured). Regression: nav-pagos works and navigates to /app/payments (payments-page). Cliente user cannot access /app/monitor (redirected to /portal).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: /app/admin/monitor/access is fetched inside AdminLayout on every mount which is fine, but consider caching in AuthContext to avoid repeated calls per nav render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ServerMonitor page fully verified in preview. Endpoints /admin/monitor/system returns real container metrics; /domains and /file-changes return available:false with note (rendered as amber warning). Plesk config unconfigured → open panel button disabled as expected. Client account correctly blocked from /app/monitor (redirected to /portal by role guard).
